summary: Implementation plan for NostrDeck, a self-publishing Android Nostr napplet & nsite launcher shell featuring a customizable home-screen launcher (icon grid / detailed list toggle + custom wallpaper), right-side Account Menu Drawer with multi-account nsec signer vault, full-page Napplets | Nsites discovery feed, sandboxed NIP-5D postMessage NAPs + optional per-applet NIP-07 runtime, in-app Creator Studio, Blossom BUD-02 uploader, and self-cloning web shell nsite publishing.
